Construction of tennis courts - the SP envisages construction of 4 tennis courts - 2 with artificial and 2

Construction of 2 open cafés:

The open café #1; will have a circular form and is installed by using cast in situ reinforced

concrete structure. The height of one-level structure will be 4.6 m with 342m² area. Reinforced

concrete slabs will be installed as well.
